// The functions of gpu/tiles.mjs, as the working version has them.
// Copied by the course's listing tool. Do not edit.

// region: TILE
export const TILE = 16; // pixels on a side of a tile
// endregion: TILE

// region: bin
// tris[k] is three [x, y] points in subpixels. Returns one list per
// tile, tile (tx, ty) at index ty * tilesX + tx, each holding the
// indices k of the triangles whose pixel bounding box touches it.
export function bin(tris, W, H, size = TILE) {
  const tilesX = Math.ceil(W / size);
  const tilesY = Math.ceil(H / size);
  const lists = Array.from({ length: tilesX * tilesY }, () => []);
  tris.forEach((tri, k) => {
    const xs = tri.map((p) => p[0]);
    const ys = tri.map((p) => p[1]);
    // the box rasterize walks, clamped to the screen
    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.min(...xs) / SUB));
    const x1 = Math.min(W, Math.ceil(Math.max(...xs) / SUB));
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.min(...ys) / SUB));
    const y1 = Math.min(H, Math.ceil(Math.max(...ys) / SUB));
    if (x0 >= x1 || y0 >= y1) return; // off the screen
    for (let ty = Math.floor(y0 / size); ty * size < y1; ty++) {
      for (let tx = Math.floor(x0 / size); tx * size < x1; tx++) {
        lists[ty * tilesX + tx].push(k);
      }
    }
  });
  return lists;
}
// endregion: bin

// region: renderTile
// ctx: { W, H, size, tris: [{ id, pts, win }], chip, background,
//        shade(t, frags), store(tx, ty, parts) }
// chip is the tile's on-chip memory, reused for every tile:
// { depth, rgba, ids }, pixel (x, y) at (y - y0) * size + (x - x0).
export function renderTile(tx, ty, list, ctx) {
  const { size, chip } = ctx;
  const x0 = tx * size;
  const y0 = ty * size;
  const rect = { x0, y0, x1: Math.min(x0 + size, ctx.W),
    y1: Math.min(y0 + size, ctx.H) };
  chip.depth.fill(1); // every tile starts far away and empty
  chip.ids.fill(-1);
  chip.rgba.set(ctx.background);
  for (const k of list) {
    const t = ctx.tris[k];
    const frags = [];
    rasterize(t.pts, rect, (x, y, w0, w1, w2) => {
      const j = (y - y0) * size + (x - x0);
      const f = interpolate(t.win, [w0, w1, w2], ATTRS.length);
      if (depthTest(chip.depth, j, f.z)) {
        frags.push({ x, y, j, attrs: f.attrs });
      }
    });
    const colours = ctx.shade(t, frags); // RGBA levels per fragment
    frags.forEach((f, n) => {
      chip.rgba.set(colours[n], f.j * 4);
      chip.ids[f.j] = t.id;
    });
  }
  ctx.store(tx, ty, ['colour']); // depth never leaves the chip
}
// endregion: renderTile
